description: 91 hospitals listed by HealthLinkBC, with address, hours and services. Published by HealthLinkBC (Province of British Columbia) as [Hospitals in BC](https://catalogue.data.gov.bc.ca/dataset/hospitals-in-bc) in the BC Data Catalogue; this is a full province-wide mirror. Query recipes and field notes are in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).

table:columns.name: CUSTODIAN_ORG_DESCRIPTION
table:columns.description: CUSTODIAN_ORG_DESCRIPTION contains the name or description of the custodial organization (usually Ministry and Branch)

table:columns.name: BUSINESS_CATEGORY_CLASS
table:columns.description: BUSINESS_CATEGORY_CLASS designates the category of business, i.e., hospitals

table:columns.name: BUSINESS_CATEGORY_DESCRIPTION
table:columns.description: BUSINESS_CATEGORY_DESCRIPTION describes the category of business, i.e., Hospitals

table:columns.name: OCCUPANT_TYPE_DESCRIPTION
table:columns.description: OCCUPANT_TYPE_DESCRIPTION contains the description of the occupant type, e.g. Hospital

table:columns.name: SOURCE_DATA_ID
table:columns.description: A unique occupant id either supplied by the source data system or produced by GSR, depending on the value of SUPPLIED_SOURCE_ID_IND

table:columns.name: SUPPLIED_SOURCE_ID_IND
table:columns.description: SUPPLIED_SOURCE_ID_IND is an indicator of whether the source data id was supplied by the supplier (Y) or DataBC (N)

table:columns.name: OCCUPANT_NAME
table:columns.description: A business name that can identify the occupant who provides the BC Government or BC Government related services to public.

table:columns.name: DESCRIPTION
table:columns.description: Describes the Occupant in more detail. e.g., Burnaby General Hospital (BGH) that is managed by Fraser Health Authority provides a wide range of integrated health care services from acute care hospitals to community-based residential, home health, mental health and public health.

table:columns.name: PHYSICAL_ADDRESS
table:columns.description: PHYSICAL_ADDRESS contains the civic or non-civic address as a single string, structured according to the specification of the Physical Address and Geocoding Standard, e.g., 420 GORGE RD E, VICTORIA, BC.

table:columns.name: ALIAS_ADDRESS
table:columns.description: ALIAS_ADDRESS contains an address string, not a parsed address. It is the address that will be displayed for presentation purposes, e.g., 32900 Marshall Road, Abbotsford, BC

table:columns.name: STREET_ADDRESS
table:columns.description: A free form expression of the site descriptor (e.g., unit) and the civic building number / street / street indicator portion of an address, e.g., Unit 1, 123 Main Street East.

table:columns.name: POSTAL_CODE
table:columns.description: The Canadian Postal code value associated with the physical address, e.g., V9Z 2K1

table:columns.name: LOCALITY
table:columns.description: The name of the municipality, community, Federal Indian Reserve (IR), subdivision, regional district, indigenous land or natural feature the occupant site is located in, e.g., Victoria, Saanich IR 1, Capital Regional District.

table:columns.name: CONTACT_PHONE
table:columns.description: Contains the "general office" phone number of the Occupant, e.g., 250-555-1234

table:columns.name: CONTACT_EMAIL
table:columns.description: Contains the "general office" email address of the Occupant.

table:columns.name: CONTACT_FAX
table:columns.description: CONTACT_FAX contains the "general office" fax number of the Occupant, e.g., 250-555-1234

table:columns.name: WEBSITE_URL
table:columns.description: Contains the link to the Home page of the Occupant's Website

table:columns.name: IMAGE_URL
table:columns.description: IMAGE_URL contains a full URL link to a picture of the Occupant's Location.

table:columns.name: KEYWORDS
table:columns.description: Contains text strings supplied by the Custodian, to be used for search/query purposes. Keywords are separated by the ; delimiter.

table:columns.name: DATE_UPDATED
table:columns.description: Contains the date that the Occupant data was updated in the Occupant structure (system-generated)

table:columns.name: SITE_GEOCODED_IND
table:columns.description: SITE_GEOCODED_IND contains a Flag/indicator (Y/N) that the Occupant Physical Address has been geo-coded by the DataBC Address Geocoder and the results provide a valid site address, e.g., Y, N

table:columns.name: HOURS
table:columns.description: Indicates the hours of operation.

table:columns.name: LANGUAGE
table:columns.description: Indicates the languages available for the Service.

table:columns.name: ORGANIZATION_NAME
table:columns.description: Describes the Organization Name.

table:columns.name: PROVINCE
table:columns.description: Indicates the Province the service is located in, i.e., BC, YT.

table:columns.name: URL_811
table:columns.description: URL Link to 811 Service Record.

table:columns.name: WHEELCHAIR_ACCESSIBLE
table:columns.description: Indicates whether Location is Wheelchair Accessible, i.e., Y, N.

table:columns.name: SERVICE_REF
table:columns.description: A unique number, called an Internal Service Key, that is assigned to uniquely identify the service or program, e.g., 17640736.

table:columns.name: SEQUENCE_ID
table:columns.description: SEQUENCE_ID contains a value to distinguish occupant instances. Where a single occupant can have multiple instances (representing different services, for example), this field distinguishes this occupant instance from other instances of the same or different occupants.

table:columns.name: SE_ANNO_CAD_DATA
table:columns.description: A binary column used by spatial tools to store annotation, curve features and CAD data when using the SDO_GEOMETRY storage data type.

table:columns.name: geometry_bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: float not null, ymin: float not null, xmax: float not null, ymax: float not null>

title: Hospitals in BC
